name: ZoLaiGPT for Android
tagline: A multilingual AI assistant for English, Myanmar and Zomi (Tedim) — developer test build for Android.
description: ZoLaiGPT for Android is the mobile app of the ZoLaiGPT project: chat, Live voice conversations, the Tedim Bible, pictures, files, subtitles and reading of social links (TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube), in English, Myanmar and Zomi (Tedim). This is a developer test build (beta): it is signed with the Android debug key, not a release key, and is meant for testing. It is installed as an APK from this website and may change. Free accounts get 100 credits every month; optional plans add more credits and models.
features: Chat in English, Myanmar and Zomi (Tedim), with Fast, Thinking and Pro models
Live voice conversations with an animated assistant
Tedim Bible, pictures, files, PDFs and translated subtitles
Reads public TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube links
Free: 100 credits every month; optional paid plans
requirements: About 172 MB of free space for the download
A Gmail account to sign in

notes: Plans & credits page with a launch offer, rub-to-reveal payment QR
Robot assistant in Live and chat, or your own photo
Answers fade in as they are written; quicker, steadier Live replies
Reads TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, Threads and Reddit links
Full privacy policy and terms in the app

installation: This is a test build signed with the Android debug key. Install it only if you are comfortable testing pre-release software.
Download the APK and wait until the whole file (about 172 MB) has finished.
Open it and allow installs from your browser or Files app when Android asks.
Install, open ZoLaiGPT and sign in with your Gmail account.
To update later, open the new APK and tap Update — your chats stay. Only if Android says “package conflicts”, uninstall the old app once and install again.

faq.q: Can I download the Android app today?
faq.a: Yes, as a developer test build (beta). It is signed with the Android debug key and is debuggable, so it is intended for testers. Check the SHA-256 checksum above before installing, and download it only from this page.
Not yet. The beta is distributed as an APK from this website; a store listing will be announced here if it is published.
Download the newest APK from this page and open it; Android installs it over the old app and keeps your chats.

This APK is signed with Android's standard debug key instead of a private release key, and debugging is enabled. That is normal for testing but not for a finished release: another debug-signed app could claim to be an update. A release-signed build will replace it; because the signing key changes, you will need to uninstall the test build once before installing the release.

privacyNote: The app's own Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are in the app (Settings → Privacy & terms). Chats are stored on your phone; messages are sent to the ZoLaiGPT server only to get answers.
